topic: the yubiOS PWC doctrine document (yubi-OS/yubiOS docs/PWC.md): program without control, the inverse of program-and-control (PAC), and the three controller-free control mechanisms

subtopics.scope: The inherited PAC model: a program plus a separate control plane that watches and intervenes (init supervisors, IAM, host agents, policy engines, PR review); the three structural costs (the controller is itself a program and a privileged target, the controller only sees its own vantage, and the controller converts a property into a procedure).

subtopics.scope: The strongest PWC mechanism: the unsafe state does not exist to be reached (immutability, capability narrowing, no mutable alias); control by construction has no runtime dependency on any process behaving.

subtopics.scope: The check and the use are the same act: dm-verity in the read path, verified boot chains, TOCTOU elimination; a poisoned byte fails to read rather than being quarantined after the fact.
